Name: Extra Large Farm
Author: Mogeekan
Description:
[b]Extra Large Map[/b] is a vanilla-style, builder-friendly farm that roughly [b]doubles the play area[/b] while preserving the look and feel of the Standard Farm. By [b]removing ponds and rivers[/b], the layout becomes a clean, uninterrupted canvas—ideal for giga crop grids, long machine lines, huge orchards, or town-like designs.
Because there’s [b]no natural water[/b], plan to [b]build a Well[/b] or lean into [b]sprinklers/irrigation[/b] early. There’s also [b]no farm fishing[/b], which helps keep the space uncluttered and focused on building. If you love big, tidy layouts with maximum control, this map was made for you.

[b]Multiple versions of the map:
[/b]Version 1: Standard farm for more farming space.
Version 2: Standard farm for more farming space and includes multiple exits on the top, right, and bottom of the farm.
[b]Note:[/b] 
Returning to the farm will always bring you back to a set return point, not to the last location you left the farm.
[b]Examples:[/b]
[b]South Border: [/b]Leaving the farm from the [b]South West OR South East[/b], and returning to the farm from the [b]South[/b] will always bring you back to the [b]South East[/b].
[b]East Border: [/b]Leaving the farm from the [b]North East OR South East[/b], and Retuning to the farm from the [b]East[/b] will always bring you back to the [b]North East[/b].
[b]North Border: [/b]Leaving the farm from the [b]North West OR North East[/b], and returning to the farm from the [b]North [/b]will always bring you back to the [b]North East[/b].

Features[list]
[*]~[b]2× the space[/b] of the Standard Farm (vanilla look & tiles)
[*][b]No natural water[/b] → wide, flat, uninterrupted building area
[*][b]Selectable farm type[/b] on New Game (doesn’t replace vanilla Farm)
[*]Great for [b]mega fields[/b], [b]machine lines[/b], [b]barn clusters[/b], and [b]aesthetic towns[/b]
[*]Plays nicely with [b]sprinkler setups[/b]; add a [b]Well[/b] early for refills
[*]Lightweight Content Patcher pack (no code)
[/list]Requirements[list]
[*][b]Stardew 1.6+[/b], [b]SMAPI[/b], [b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*]New save to start on this farm (doesn’t alter existing saves)
[/list]Notes[list]
[*]No farm fishing; place Wells or rely on sprinklers for watering.
[*]If another mod also adds a custom farm type, both can appear together.
[*]1.1.4+ Now allows custom textures.
[*]1.5.0+ Added a second version of the farm which has multiple exits.
[/list]1.6.+ Fixed the issue where coop was not working/freezing and crashing.

[b]Platforms:[/b]
✔ PC (1.6+) with SMAPI + Content Patcher
✔ Android (1.6+) with compatible SMAPI + Content Patcher build
[b]Mobile players[/b]: you’ll need the current Android SMAPI + Content Patcher install. If you have issues, check your SMAPI log at smapi.io/log and share it in the comments.[list]
[size=4][b]Please note, if an error pops up in SMAPI console about a missing icon.png in the assets folder; this is an issue with Nexus mods and not the mod, the fix to this is to uninstall the mod through nexus mods and then download manually and place in the mods folder.

[b]Q: Why do stumps keep respawning on this map?[/b]
A: The map itself doesn’t make stumps respawn. That behavior usually comes from mods like [b]Farm Type Manager[/b] (look for [code]LargeObjectSpawnEnabled[/code] in your FTM config) or other resource-spawner mods. If you want them to stop respawning, either disable that feature in the other mod’s config, or cover the stump tiles with flooring/buildings/chests so they can’t respawn there.
[/b][/size][/list]
